rule.name: StreamedRowsCollected
rule.message: This stream reads rows from the database one at a time, but the whole result is collected into one collection, so every row is held in memory at once, which is what streaming avoids and what runs out of memory on a large table. Handle each row inside forEach, or flush a fixed-size batch there (add, and at 500 rows save the batch and clear it), and the rest once after it. An exception fits only for a query that always returns a handful of rows.
